verdict.rationale: An observability dashboard for background jobs could plausibly offer AI-generated insights, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows AI insights or suggestions inside the product. Query/TRQL is manual SQL-style querying, and the MCP server lets external AI assistants monitor runs rather than delivering insights within Trigger.dev. The AI chat and prompt features are building blocks for developers' own agents, not AI analysis of the user's data.
